summary: Complete the incomplete research2 CLI routing and repair the output_json signature regression. The proposed edits add a real --caps2 dispatch, a v2 preflight/run path for --e2-ext/--method using ioctl 0x10 then 0x0f, retain the legacy --e2/--cost 0x0e path and validators unchanged, and add the missing research2 config/raw/E2-D80/method-E00 checks. Host stub/tests are updated to exercise real routing, preflight rejection before DMA, post-return corruption, and legacy regression.

edits.new: output_json(&o, reqp, raw, r2, success, validated, rc, saved_errno, stage_name, err);

def run_v2(args, stub_mode="ok", good=True, calls=("caps2", "run2")):
            nonlocal checks
            caps2_role = 2 if "--method" in args else 1
            rc, row, actual = raw_run(args, stub_mode, caps2_role)
            assert (rc == 0) == good, (stub_mode, args, rc, row)
            assert row["schema"] == "idma-research-v1", row
            assert row["success"] == good, (stub_mode, args, row)
            assert actual == list(calls), (stub_mode, args, actual)
            checks += 1
            return row

tests: Host compile of bench/idma_research.c with -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 and tests/research2_cli_stub.c as a shared LD_PRELOAD object
risks: The proposed code is a patch; it has not been executed here. Compile and host tests must be rerun by the parent after applying edits.

The new preflight requires CAPS2 role to match the requested CLI role. On a real BIT that exposes only one role, the other role will be rejected before DMA, which is intended but must match the hardware profile strategy.

F03 validation assumes the feature-bit definitions in docs/research-two-bit-v2.md and the existing stub test mask (0x7 for role 1, 0x8 for role 2). If RTL exposes additional reserved or available bits, this validator will reject them.

The method E03 check expects frozen=1, armed=0, abort=0 after a successful run. If the kernel exposes a different completion state, this must be revisited; the corrected FREEZE/ABORT retention policy is only represented by this normal-success predicate.

The config-echo check assumes the kernel must not normalize or mutate the input idma_research2_config. If kernel code legitimately updates any config field, the comparison must be relaxed to the contractually returned fields.
Tests are host LD_PRELOAD ioctl-stub tests only; they do not establish board or RTL behavior. The stub's new IDMA_TEST_CAPS2_ROLE environment variable is test-only scaffolding.
